newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Nov 4.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $28 billion of three- and six-month bills on November 4 to raise $1.175 billion as $26.828 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued November 7. The three-month bills mature on February 6 and the six-month bills mature on May 8.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127942L7 and for the six-month bills is 9127944H4.
